# Nisc Cloud

> Build. Run. Grow. One accountable technology partner.

Nisc Cloud is a cloud infrastructure and cloud hosting provider that brings cloud infrastructure, software and digital growth together in one connected operation for businesses, agencies and developers. Through nPanel, customers build their website, run domains, hosting, business email and servers, and grow with marketing and Zepo AI, all from one account. Unlike all-in-one website and marketing platforms that run on someone else's cloud, Nisc Cloud operates the hosting and servers underneath, so one team supports everything from the website to the infrastructure. Since 2019.

## Build. Run. Grow.

1. **Build** Brand identity, website design and development, ecommerce stores and custom software.
2. **Run** Domains (.ke, .co.ke, .com and more), web hosting, WordPress hosting, business email, VPS, VDS, dedicated servers, SSL certificates and website security. Hosting, email, cloud servers and domains carry a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment, set out in the Service Level Agreement.
3. **Grow** SEO / AEO / GEO, Google, Meta and TikTok advertising, social media management and email marketing.
4. **Zepo AI** Support for customer conversations, follow-ups and repetitive workflows in the services where it is available.

## Accreditation

- KeNIC-accredited registrar for .ke domains
- Licensed by the Communications Authority of Kenya
- Registered data controller with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019)

## Why Work With Us

- Clients range from small and medium businesses to corporate organisations with more than 2,500 employees
- A dedicated account manager for managed services
- One account (nPanel) for services, invoices, renewals and support
- Clear plans; prices shown exclude 16% VAT
- Critical issues are supported 24/7 by ticket or Zepo AI. Other requests are handled Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00 East Africa Time
- Pay with M-Pesa or card
- KRA eTIMS-compliant invoices
- Free strategy call before you commit to marketing work

## Common Questions

- **Is website migration free?** Yes, within the scope agreed before the move. Extra work is quoted first and only charged once the client approves it.
- **What content is not allowed?** Illegal content, malware, spam, pornography, scams such as Ponzi or get-rich-quick schemes, and sites impersonating genuine businesses. Accounts that break these rules can be suspended without refund (see the Terms of Service).
- **Can I buy without talking to sales?** Yes. Domains, hosting, business email, servers and SSL certificates can be bought online with prices shown before checkout. Websites, software, marketing and larger infrastructure projects start with a conversation.
- **Who is Nisc Cloud for?** Businesses that want their digital services in one place, developers who need hosting and server control, and agencies that manage services for several clients.
- **Do you work with businesses outside Kenya?** Yes. Prices are shown in KES or USD depending on location, payment is by M-Pesa or card, and support runs through nPanel, email and WhatsApp.
- **How long does a website take?** A Small Business site (up to 5 pages) is often planned at about 10 days, and a Corporate project at about 21 days. Growth is confirmed in the proposal. Content and feedback affect the schedule.
- **How are websites, stores, brand work and custom software priced?** They are quoted in a proposal. There is no public price list and no hourly billing. You pay 50% to start and 50% at launch. SEO, social media, paid ads and email marketing keep their published plans.
- **Is there a long contract?** Monthly services are month to month with 30 days notice to cancel. One-off projects are paid 50% to start and 50% at launch.

## Pricing

Current prices, billing cycles and renewal prices are on https://nisccloud.com/pricing and on each product page. Domain prices appear after you search. Corporate and enterprise requirements are quoted.

## Cloud Products

- [Hosting Overview](https://nisccloud.com/hosting): All hosting products
- [Web Hosting](https://nisccloud.com/hosting/web-hosting): Business web hosting with email included, NVMe storage, a CDN, DDoS protection, daily backups and a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment. Served from Nairobi to businesses in Kenya (KES, M-Pesa, .ke domains through a KeNIC-accredited registrar) and to customers elsewhere (USD).
